brdf: RT1 single-scattering GGX at unit Fresnel: height-correlated Smith visibility with a 1e-6 denominator floor
rows: linear in sqrt(alpha) over [0, 1]; row 0 is a unit-albedo mirror
columns: uniform in x = 1 - sqrt(1 - 2 theta_s / pi), theta_s = atan2(alpha sin theta, cos theta)
averageDeficit: 2 * integral of (1 - E(mu)) mu dmu for the clamped bilinear interpolant E, a Stieltjes sum over exact sin^2(theta) increments of each column cell
